title: Now playing
description: Whatever your Mac is playing, in the menu bar, as Control Center's Now Playing sees it: Music, Spotify, a YouTube tab in Chrome, Safari or Zen, any app. Click it for the track with its artwork and artist, how far in, play or pause, previous and next; Favourite while Music plays. Click the track to go to the tab or app playing it. Never starts a player; going to a browser tab asks once to control that browser, Favourite once to control Music.
examples: A YouTube video plays in Chrome: the menu bar shows ♫ and its title; a lone ♫ while paused, nothing when nothing has played
Click it, then the track: Chrome comes forward on the YouTube tab that plays it
